notes: Wave 0 of EVENT-PROCESSING-SPEC.md. The spec written yesterday describes a Complex Event Processing engine and a portfolio-level strategy backtester across seven waves. This release ships the *first* one, and it deliberately contains no engine at all: no condition language, no rule evaluation, no actions, no paper book, no backtest. What it ships instead is the thing that has to exist before any of that is honest — the disclosure of what could be reconstructed, and the beginning of the record that will one day make more of it reconstructable.
